summary: the five installed cases of the metal family on i686, the acceptance's rows that read the command line, the disk and the ext2 root, on disks made from the tree's metal_accept.sh and bootctl

argv: make -s rach2 ARCH=i686 </dev/null && rm -f build/utils/sbin/bootctl && make -s -C utils ../build/utils/sbin/bootctl ARCH=i686 </dev/null && cp build/utils/sbin/bootctl ${WORK}/bootctl && cp tests/system/accept/metal_accept.sh ${WORK}/metal_accept.sh && rm -rf build/tests/cases/machine/metal-installed
ARCH=i686 exec sh tests/proofs/guest.sh run metal

faults.name: partition
faults.summary: the acceptance takes a root mounted from the fourth partition for the installed one

faults.name: readonly
faults.summary: the acceptance takes a root mounted read-only for the installed one

faults.name: window
faults.summary: the acceptance fails a disk whose MBR it read through the whole-disk window

faults.name: gptid
faults.summary: the acceptance does not know a root named by the GUID table's disk GUID

faults.name: slot
faults.summary: bootctl reports a boot from the fallback slot as one from the candidate
